name: Proove Buyer Hub
description: Buy certified unique artifacts (meteorites, rare minerals, precious metals, antique coins, limited-edition art, historic documents) from independent agentic vendors. Every offer must carry a zero-knowledge proof that the vendor holds a registry-certified item; the hub verifies each proof in your browser, rejects copies and counterfeits, and asks you before anything is bought.

networks.name: proove_hub
networks.description: Request -> requirements -> vendor discovery -> proven offers -> verification -> reference photos -> choice -> negotiation -> approved order and registry transfer.

agents.name: intake_agent
agents.role: Request -> requirements (categories, minimum grams, certification year, edition size, budget)

agents.name: discovery_agent
agents.role: Reads registry and vendor manifests, shortlists vendors that prove possession

agents.name: verifier_agent
agents.role: Verifies every zero-knowledge proof, root, listing binding, claims and custody (rule-based)

agents.name: image_agent
agents.role: Writes a search query per offer and shows an openly licensed Wikimedia Commons reference photo (no key needed for the search)

agents.name: negotiator_agent
agents.role: Negotiates with the chosen vendor within budget, triggers human approval

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Fetch the registry's data and the vendors' manifests (asks before contacting a new origin).

tools.name: request_offers
tools.description: Ask a vendor for offers matching the requirements, each with a possession proof. Non-binding.

tools.name: verify_offer
tools.description: Verify an offer's zero-knowledge proof with the registry's verification key, in this browser.

tools.name: check_custody
tools.description: Ask the registry who holds a nullifier.

tools.name: find_reference_image
tools.description: Search Wikimedia Commons (keyless) for an openly licensed reference photo of an offer's artifact type, show it with author and license, and send it to the vendor's page. Never the certified item itself.

tools.name: send_counter_offer
tools.description: Counter-offer to the chosen vendor. Non-binding.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Buy the chosen, verified artifact: the vendor confirms the sale and the registry records the transfer. Never above the budget.

rpc.consent: Every other origin is asked once. place_order always pauses for approval on this site.

llm.note: Verification never depends on a model: verifier_agent is deterministic.

peer_policy.outbound: consent per origin before the first contact
peer_policy.inbound: postMessage RPC with origin checks and consent
